style: .rt-footer{padding:clamp(3.5rem,7vw,7rem) clamp(1.1rem,4vw,4.5rem) 1.5rem;background:#111;color:#fff}.rt-footer__newsletter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(2rem,8vw,8rem);align-items:end;padding-bottom:4rem}.rt-footer__newsletter p{color:var(--store-highlight,var(--store-role-10,#f59e0b));font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em}.rt-footer__newsletter h2{margin:.4rem 0;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,4.5vw,5rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1}.rt-footer__newsletter span{display:block;max-width:560px;margin-top:1rem;color:#a8a29e;line-height:1.7}.rt-footer form{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid #78716c}.rt-footer input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:1rem 0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font:inherit}.rt-footer button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}.rt-footer__bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:2rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid #292524;color:#a8a29e;font-size:.78rem}.rt-footer nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1.5rem}.rt-footer a{text-decoration:none}@media(max-width:700px){.rt-footer__newsletter{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rt-footer__bottom{flex-direction:column}}
